verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents multi-session support ('start multiple agents in parallel on the same project'), subagents with different models, a headless server/SDK for programmatic control, and an --auto flag for autonomous permission approval — all building blocks for parallel autonomous agents. However, there's no evidence of fleet-scale orchestration or hours/days-long autonomous runs, and community reports note agents 'randomly get stuck, especially for long/nested sessions,' undercutting long-horizon reliability. Missing for 10: documented support for many concurrent agents (fleet-scale), evidence of multi-hour/day unattended runs, and reliability data for long-running sessions.
